source.title: Sydney Elliott and W. D. Flackes, Northern Ireland: A Political Directory 1968-1999 (Belfast: Blackstaff Press, 1999), Dictionary, p. 321
source.check: McAleese 62, Reynolds 48 read on the scan of p. 321, which dates the contest September 1997; the day is from The Irish Times, 18 September 1997, cited for the first ballot

note: Second ballot of the Fianna Fáil parliamentary party's choice of its candidate for the 1997 presidential election, 17 September 1997: Mary McAleese was chosen over Albert Reynolds. She was not a member of the party, so no party label is given for her. A party-internal contest: the electorate is the parliamentary party, not the public.
